statement: A tx that stops applying while it waits in the mempool is refused with notice to its owner at propose and leaves the mempool; never dropped silently. A tx the peer refuses inside a frame (R-FRAME-REFUSAL) is either retried (a fault that passes with the peer's view) or dropped with notice (fault peer_refused, carrying the peer's fault tag): every tx that enters a mempool ends committed or refused with notice, which the liveness simulation counts. The Quint cell holds the drop with notice (every tx ends committed or refused, `refused` is a list of txs); the fault peer_refused and the peer's fault tag on the notice are not in the model.

killers.name: R-NOTICE a queued tx that stops applying is refused with its fault at propose, never dropped
R-NOTICE a frame of only refused txs sends nothing and leaves no pending frame
R-NOTICE a rolled-back tx whose ground moved is refused at the next propose, with notice
R-NOTICE no submitted tx is lost: committed, held, or refused, in every state of the page
R-NOTICE R-ADMIT a refused tx has a conflicting predecessor in the submitted txs, in every state of the page
R-NOTICE no tx is both committed and refused, in every state of the page
R-NOTICE a frame with no txs is refused and moves nothing: the peer cannot spin the height
account/frame R-FRAME-REFUSAL a frame the peer cannot apply is taken back
